#ifndef RDT_H
#define RDT_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/** Size in bytes of the fixed portion of an RDT datagram. */
#define RDT_HEADER_SIZE 10U

/** Maximum number of file-data bytes carried by one DATA datagram. */
#define RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD 1024U

/** Maximum total RDT datagram size, including its header. */
#define RDT_MAX_PACKET (RDT_HEADER_SIZE + RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD)

/**
 * RDT datagram type values. These values are part of the wire protocol.
 */
enum rdt_packet_type
{
  RDT_DATA = 0,
  RDT_ACK = 1,
  RDT_FIN = 2
};

/**
 * Configuration for a transfer and its relay registration.
 *
 * The session string is used during the relay HELLO handshake. window_size and
 * timeout_ms are used by the sender; loss, corrupt, and duplicate are sent to
 * the relay in the sender's HELLO. port selects the relay's UDP port.
 */
struct rdt_options
{
  const char *session;       /**< Shared relay session name. */
  unsigned int window_size;  /**< Sender's Go-Back-N window, 1-64 packets. */
  unsigned int timeout_ms;   /**< Sender retransmission timeout in ms. */
  unsigned short port;       /**< Relay UDP port. */
  double loss;               /**< Relay packet-loss probability, 0-0.5. */
  double corrupt;            /**< Relay packet-corruption probability, 0-0.5. */
  double duplicate;          /**< Relay duplication probability, 0-0.5. */
};

/**
 * Check the session-name syntax expected by the relay.
 *
 * @param session Name to validate; must contain 1-32 lowercase letters,
 *                digits, or hyphens.
 * @return 0 when valid, or -1 for NULL or an invalid name.
 */
int rdt_validate_session(const char *session);

/**
 * Encode one RDT datagram into its wire representation.
 *
 * The header consists of type, a zero reserved byte, a 16-bit Internet
 * checksum, a 32-bit sequence number, and a 16-bit payload length. Multi-byte
 * fields are in network byte order.
 *
 * @param packet Destination buffer.
 * @param capacity Available bytes in packet.
 * @param type DATA, ACK, or FIN.
 * @param sequence 32-bit datagram sequence number.
 * @param payload Payload bytes, or NULL when payload_length is zero.
 * @param payload_length Payload size, at most RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD.
 * @return Encoded datagram length, or 0 if the arguments/capacity are invalid.
 */
size_t rdt_encode_packet(uint8_t *packet, size_t capacity,
                         enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                         const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t payload_length);

/**
 * Validate and decode an RDT datagram.
 *
 * Optional output pointers may be NULL. The decoded payload points into the
 * input packet and remains valid only as long as that packet's storage.
 *
 * @param packet Datagram bytes to validate.
 * @param packet_length Datagram size.
 * @param type Receives the decoded type, when non-NULL.
 * @param sequence Receives the decoded sequence number, when non-NULL.
 * @param payload Receives a pointer to the payload, when non-NULL.
 * @param payload_length Receives the payload size, when non-NULL.
 * @return 0 on success, or -1 for invalid type, reserved byte, length, or
 *         checksum.
 */
int rdt_decode_packet(const uint8_t *packet, size_t packet_length,
                      enum rdt_packet_type *type, uint32_t *sequence,
                      const uint8_t **payload, uint32_t *payload_length);

/**
 * Send a regular file through the relay using Go-Back-N.
 *
 * Registers as the session sender, sends the file in RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD-sized
 * DATA chunks, retransmits unacknowledged windows on timeout, then retries FIN
 * until its final ACK arrives or ten FIN timeouts expire.
 *
 * @param host Relay host name or numeric address.
 * @param port Relay UDP port.
 * @param path Path to the regular input file.
 * @param options Transfer and relay settings.
 * @return 0 on success, 2 if FIN receives no ACK after ten retransmission
 *         timeouts, or 1 for other failures.
 */
int rdt_send_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                  const struct rdt_options *options);

/**
 * Receive one file through the relay.
 *
 * Registers as the session receiver, writes only DATA at the next expected
 * sequence number, sends cumulative ACKs for received or discarded packets,
 * then acknowledges FIN and lingers through the sender's bounded FIN retry
 * period.
 *
 * @param host Relay host name or numeric address.
 * @param port Relay UDP port.
 * @param path Destination file path; it is opened/truncated after registration.
 * @param options Transfer and relay settings.
 * @return 0 on success, 2 if no valid packet arrives for 30 seconds, or 1 for
 *         other file or communication failures.
 */
int rdt_receive_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                     const struct rdt_options *options);

#endif
```

#ifndef RDT_PROTOCOL_H
#define RDT_PROTOCOL_H

#include "rdt.h"

/**
 * Injectable operations used by the protocol state machines.
 *
 * The protocol layer owns RDT packet sequencing, acknowledgements, timeout
 * decisions, and retransmission. The adapter owns the implementations of
 * these network, clock, and file operations.
 */
struct rdt_protocol_io
{
  void *context; /**< Opaque adapter state passed to every callback. */
  /** Send exactly one datagram; return 0 on success and -1 on failure. */
  int (*send_datagram)(void *context, const uint8_t *packet, size_t length);
  /**
   * Receive a datagram. Return 0 and set length when received, 1 on timeout,
   * or -1 on I/O failure.
   */
  int (*receive_datagram)(void *context, uint8_t *packet, size_t capacity,
                          size_t *length, int timeout_ms);
  /** Return the current monotonic time in milliseconds. */
  uint64_t (*now_ms)(void *context);
  /** Read/write the complete requested byte count; return 0 or -1. */
  int (*read_file)(void *context, uint8_t *bytes, size_t length);
  int (*write_file)(void *context, const uint8_t *bytes, size_t length);
  /** Flush received file bytes to the destination; return 0 or -1. */
  int (*flush_file)(void *context);
  /** Close the destination file before FIN ACK; return 0 or -1. */
  int (*close_file)(void *context);
};

/** Run the sender state machine over supplied datagram, clock, and file I/O. */
int rdt_protocol_send(const struct rdt_protocol_io *io,
                      uint64_t file_size,
                      const struct rdt_options *options);

/** Run the receiver state machine over supplied datagram, clock, and file I/O. */
int rdt_protocol_receive(const struct rdt_protocol_io *io,
                         const struct rdt_options *options);

#endif
```

</details>

#ifndef RDT_IO_H
#define RDT_IO_H

#include "rdt_protocol.h"

struct rdt_io_context;

/*
 * Concrete operating-system adapter: owns the UDP socket, relay HELLO,
 * monotonic clock, and source/destination FILE.
 */

/**
 * Resolve/connect the relay, complete HELLO, and open the source/destination.

                            struct rdt_protocol_io *io);

#include "rdt.h"

#include "rdt_io.h"
#include "rdt_protocol.h"

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/*
 * Packet serialization layer. It owns the wire format and does not perform
 * network, timer, or file operations.
 */
static uint16_t read_u16(const uint8_t *bytes)
{
  uint16_t network_value;
  memcpy(&network_value, bytes, sizeof(network_value));
  return ntohs(network_value);
}

static uint32_t read_u32(const uint8_t *bytes)
{
  uint32_t network_value;
  memcpy(&network_value, bytes, sizeof(network_value));
  return ntohl(network_value);
}

static void write_u16(uint8_t *bytes, uint16_t value)
{
  uint16_t network_value = htons(value);
  memcpy(bytes, &network_value, sizeof(network_value));
}

static void write_u32(uint8_t *bytes, uint32_t value)
{
  uint32_t network_value = htonl(value);
  memcpy(bytes, &network_value, sizeof(network_value));
}

/* Internet checksum with the checksum field temporarily treated as zero. */
static uint16_t internet_checksum(const uint8_t *packet, size_t length,
                                 int zero_checksum)
{
  uint32_t sum = 0U;
  size_t offset = 0U;

  while (offset + 1U < length)
  {
    uint16_t word;
    if (zero_checksum != 0 && offset == 2U)
    {
      word = 0U;
    }
    else
    {
      word = (uint16_t) (((uint16_t) packet[offset] << 8) |
                         (uint16_t) packet[offset + 1U]);
    }
    sum += (uint32_t) word;
    offset += 2U;
  }
  if (offset < length)
  {
    sum += (uint32_t) ((uint16_t) packet[offset] << 8);
  }
  while ((sum >> 16) != 0U)
  {
    sum = (sum & UINT32_C(0xffff)) + (sum >> 16);
  }
  return (uint16_t) ~sum;
}

int rdt_validate_session(const char *session)
{
  size_t i;
  size_t length;

  if (session == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  length = strlen(session);
  if (length == 0U || length > 32U)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  for (i = 0U; i < length; ++i)
  {
    char character = session[i];
    if (!((character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') ||
          (character >= '0' && character <= '9') || character == '-'))
    {
      return -1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

size_t rdt_encode_packet(uint8_t *packet, size_t capacity,
                         enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                         const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t payload_length)
{
  size_t packet_length;

  if (packet == NULL || payload_length > RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD ||
      (payload_length > 0U && payload == NULL) ||
      (type != RDT_DATA && type != RDT_ACK && type != RDT_FIN))
  {
    return 0U;
  }
  packet_length = RDT_HEADER_SIZE + (size_t) payload_length;
  if (capacity < packet_length)
  {
    return 0U;
  }

  packet[0] = (uint8_t) type;
  packet[1] = 0U;
  write_u16(packet + 2U, 0U);
  write_u32(packet + 4U, sequence);
  write_u16(packet + 8U, (uint16_t) payload_length);
  if (payload_length > 0U)
  {
    memcpy(packet + RDT_HEADER_SIZE, payload, (size_t) payload_length);
  }
  write_u16(packet + 2U, internet_checksum(packet, packet_length, 1));
  return packet_length;
}

int rdt_decode_packet(const uint8_t *packet, size_t packet_length,
                      enum rdt_packet_type *type, uint32_t *sequence,
                      const uint8_t **payload, uint32_t *payload_length)
{
  uint16_t decoded_length;

  if (packet == NULL || packet_length < RDT_HEADER_SIZE || packet[1] != 0U ||
      (packet[0] != RDT_DATA && packet[0] != RDT_ACK &&
       packet[0] != RDT_FIN))
  {
    return -1;
  }

  decoded_length = read_u16(packet + 8U);
  if (decoded_length > RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD ||
      packet_length != RDT_HEADER_SIZE + (size_t) decoded_length ||
      internet_checksum(packet, packet_length, 0) != 0U)
  {
    return -1;
  }

  if (type != NULL)
  {
    *type = (enum rdt_packet_type) packet[0];
  }
  if (sequence != NULL)
  {
    *sequence = read_u32(packet + 4U);
  }
  if (payload != NULL)
  {
    *payload = packet + RDT_HEADER_SIZE;
  }
  if (payload_length != NULL)
  {
    *payload_length = decoded_length;
  }
  return 0;
}

/*
 * Public entry points compose the I/O adapter with the protocol state machine.
 */
int rdt_send_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                  const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *context;
  struct rdt_protocol_io io;
  uint64_t file_size = 0U;
  int result;
  int close_result;

  context = rdt_io_open(host, port, path, options, 1, &file_size);
  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return 1;
  }
  rdt_io_get_protocol_io(context, &io);
  result = rdt_protocol_send(&io, file_size, options);
  close_result = rdt_io_close(context);

  if (result == 0 && close_result == 0)
  {
    printf("Transfer complete: %" PRIu64 " bytes sent to %s\n", file_size,
           host);
    return 0;
  }
  return result == 2 ? 2 : 1;
}

int rdt_receive_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                     const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *context;
  struct rdt_protocol_io io;
  int result;
  int close_result;

  context = rdt_io_open(host, port, path, options, 0, NULL);
  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return 1;
  }
  rdt_io_get_protocol_io(context, &io);
  result = rdt_protocol_receive(&io, options);
  close_result = rdt_io_close(context);

  if (result == 0 && close_result == 0)
  {
    printf("Transfer complete: file received from %s\n", host);
    return 0;
  }
  return result == 2 ? 2 : 1;
}

static int open_relay_socket(const char *host, unsigned short port)
{
  struct addrinfo hints;
  struct addrinfo *addresses = NULL;
  struct addrinfo *address;
  char service[6];
  int socket_fd = -1;
  int status;

  memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
  hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
  hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_DGRAM;
  hints.ai_protocol = IPPROTO_UDP;
  (void) snprintf(service, sizeof(service), "%u", (unsigned int) port);

  status = getaddrinfo(host, service, &hints, &addresses);
  if (status != 0) // GCOVR_EXCL_START
  {
    fprintf(stderr, "Cannot resolve relay '%s': %s\n", host,
            gai_strerror(status));
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP

  for (address = addresses; address != NULL; address = address->ai_next)
  {
    socket_fd = socket(address->ai_family, address->ai_socktype,
                       address->ai_protocol);
    if (socket_fd < 0) // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    {

  do
  {
    result = poll(&descriptor, 1U, timeout_ms);
  } while (result < 0 && errno == EINTR);

  if (result < 0)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "UDP wait failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  if (result == 0)
  {
    return 0;
  }
  if ((descriptor.revents & POLLIN) != 0)
  {
    return 1;
  }
  // GCOVR_EXCL_START
  fprintf(stderr, "UDP socket reported an error while waiting\n");
  return -1;
  // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
}

static int receive_datagram(void *context, uint8_t *packet, size_t capacity,
                            size_t *length, int timeout_ms)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *io = context;
  int ready = wait_readable(io->socket_fd, timeout_ms);
  ssize_t received;

  if (ready <= 0)
  {
    return ready == 0 ? 1 : -1;
  }
  do
  {
    received = recv(io->socket_fd, packet, capacity, 0);
  } while (received < 0 && errno == EINTR);

  if (received < 0)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "UDP receive failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  *length = (size_t) received;
  return 0;
}

static uint64_t monotonic_milliseconds(void *context)
{
  struct timespec now;
  (void) context;

  if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now) != 0)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not read monotonic clock: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    return 0U;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  return (uint64_t) now.tv_sec * UINT64_C(1000) +
         (uint64_t) now.tv_nsec / UINT64_C(1000000);
}

static int read_file(void *context, uint8_t *bytes, size_t length)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *io = context;

  if (fread(bytes, 1U, length, io->file) != length)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not read input file: %s\n",
            ferror(io->file) != 0 ? strerror(errno) : "unexpected end of file");
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  return 0;
}

static int write_file(void *context, const uint8_t *bytes, size_t length)
{

  if (fwrite(bytes, 1U, length, io->file) != length)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not write output file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  return 0;
}

static int flush_file(void *context)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *io = context;

  if (fflush(io->file) != 0)
  {// GCOVR_EXCL_START

    return -1;
  }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  return 0;
}

static int close_file(void *context)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *io = context;
  FILE *file = io->file;

  if (file == NULL)
  {
    return 0;
  }

struct linger_test_context
{
  uint64_t now_ms;
  uint8_t incoming[4][RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  size_t incoming_lengths[4];
  size_t incoming_count;
  size_t next_incoming;
  uint32_t acknowledgements[4];
  size_t acknowledgement_count;
  uint8_t written[8];
  size_t written_length;
  unsigned int flush_count;
  unsigned int close_count;
  int fin_ack_before_close;
};

static int linger_test_send(void *context, const uint8_t *packet,
                            size_t length)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  enum rdt_packet_type type;
  uint32_t sequence;

  if (test->acknowledgement_count >=
          sizeof(test->acknowledgements) / sizeof(test->acknowledgements[0]) ||
      rdt_decode_packet(packet, length, &type, &sequence, NULL, NULL) != 0 ||
      type != RDT_ACK)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->acknowledgements[test->acknowledgement_count] = sequence;
  if (sequence == 2U && test->close_count == 0U)
  {
    test->fin_ack_before_close = 1;
  }
  ++test->acknowledgement_count;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_receive(void *context, uint8_t *packet,
                               size_t capacity, size_t *length,
                               int timeout_ms)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;

  if (test->next_incoming < test->incoming_count)
  {
    size_t packet_length = test->incoming_lengths[test->next_incoming];
    if (capacity < packet_length)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    memcpy(packet, test->incoming[test->next_incoming], packet_length);
    *length = packet_length;
    ++test->next_incoming;
    return 0;
  }
  if (timeout_ms < 0)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->now_ms += (uint64_t) timeout_ms;
  return 1;
}

static uint64_t linger_test_clock(void *context)
{
  const struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  return test->now_ms;
}

static int linger_test_read(void *context, uint8_t *bytes, size_t length)
{
  (void) context;
  (void) bytes;
  (void) length;
  return -1;
}

static int linger_test_write(void *context, const uint8_t *bytes,
                             size_t length)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;

  if (length > sizeof(test->written) - test->written_length)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  memcpy(test->written + test->written_length, bytes, length);
  test->written_length += length;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_flush(void *context)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  ++test->flush_count;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_close(void *context)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  ++test->close_count;
  return 0;
}

static int queue_linger_packet(struct linger_test_context *test,
                               enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                               const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t length)
{
  size_t packet_length;

  if (test->incoming_count >=
      sizeof(test->incoming) / sizeof(test->incoming[0]))
  {
    return -1;
  }
  packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(test->incoming[test->incoming_count],
                                    sizeof(test->incoming[0]), type, sequence,
                                    payload, length);
  if (packet_length == 0U)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->incoming_lengths[test->incoming_count] = packet_length;
  ++test->incoming_count;
  return 0;
}

{

### Copilot

**Partially, but not fully.** Packet encoding and validation are pure functions, and OS-specific operations such as `poll`, `clock_gettime`, UDP I/O, and file access are implemented in the I/O adapter.

The main gap is the Go-Back-N layer: `rdt_protocol.c` is not a standalone event-driven state machine. Its send/receive functions call injected callbacks for network, clock, and file operations rather than accepting events such as “ACK arrived” or “timer expired” and returning actions. The callbacks make parts of the logic testable with fakes, but they do not meet the specified state-machine interface, and the I/O layer is not the sole driver of protocol events.

static int relay_handshake(struct rdt_io_context *io,
                           const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  char hello[128];
  int hello_length;
  int attempt;

  if (io->sender != 0)
  {
    hello_length = snprintf(hello, sizeof(hello),
                            "HELLO %s send %.17f %.17f %.17f",
                            options->session, options->loss,
                            options->corrupt, options->duplicate);
  }
  else
  {
    hello_length = snprintf(hello, sizeof(hello), "HELLO %s recv",
                            options->session);
  }
  if (hello_length < 0 || (size_t) hello_length >= sizeof(hello))
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not construct relay HELLO message\n");
    return -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP

  /* HELLO and its reply are not impaired; retries cover UDP loss. */
  for (attempt = 0; attempt < HELLO_ATTEMPTS; ++attempt)
  {
    uint8_t response[256];
    size_t response_length = 0U;
    int ready;
    ssize_t received;

    if (send_datagram(io, (const uint8_t *) hello,
                      (size_t) hello_length) != 0)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    ready = wait_readable(io->socket_fd, HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS);
    if (ready < 0)
    {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
      return -1;
    }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
    if (ready == 0)
    {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
      continue;
    }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
    do
    {
      received = recv(io->socket_fd, response, sizeof(response) - 1U, 0);
    } while (received < 0 && errno == EINTR);
    if (received < 0)
    {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
      fprintf(stderr, "UDP receive failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
      return -1;
    }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
    response_length = (size_t) received;
    response[response_length] = '\0';
    if (response_length == 2U && memcmp(response, "OK", 2U) == 0)
    {
      return 0;
    }
    if (response_length >= 4U && memcmp(response, "ERR ", 4U) == 0)
    {
      fprintf(stderr, "Relay rejected HELLO: %s\n", response + 4U);
    }
    else
    {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
      fprintf(stderr, "Unexpected relay HELLO response: %s\n", response);
    }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
    return -1;
  }
  // GCOVR_EXCL_START
  fprintf(stderr, "Relay did not answer HELLO after %d attempts\n",
          HELLO_ATTEMPTS);
  return -1;
  // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
}

struct rdt_io_context *rdt_io_open(const char *host, unsigned short port,
                                   const char *path,
                                   const struct rdt_options *options,
                                   int sender, uint64_t *file_size)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *io;
  struct stat file_status;

  if (host == NULL || path == NULL || options == NULL ||
      rdt_validate_session(options->session) != 0 ||
      (sender != 0 && sender != 1))
  {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Invalid endpoint or relay options\n");
    return NULL;
  }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP

  io = calloc(1U, sizeof(*io));
  if (io == NULL)
  {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not allocate I/O context: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    return NULL;
  }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  io->socket_fd = -1;
  io->sender = sender;

  if (sender != 0)
  {
    io->file = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (io->file == NULL)
    {
      fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open input file '%s': %s\n", path,
              strerror(errno));
      rdt_io_close(io);
      return NULL;
    }
    if (fstat(fileno(io->file), &file_status) != 0 ||
        !S_ISREG(file_status.st_mode) || file_status.st_size < 0)
    {
      fprintf(stderr, "Input must be a readable regular file\n");
      rdt_io_close(io);
      return NULL;
    }
    if (file_size != NULL)
    {
      *file_size = (uint64_t) file_status.st_size;
    }
  }

  io->socket_fd = open_relay_socket(host, port);
  if (io->socket_fd < 0)
  {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
    rdt_io_close(io);
    return NULL;
  }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  if (relay_handshake(io, options) != 0)
  {
    rdt_io_close(io);
    return NULL;
  }

  if (sender == 0)
  {
    io->file = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (io->file == NULL)
    {
      fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open output file '%s': %s\n", path,
              strerror(errno));
      rdt_io_close(io);
      return NULL;
    }
  }
  return io;
}

void rdt_io_get_protocol_io(struct rdt_io_context *context,
                            struct rdt_protocol_io *protocol_io)
{
  if (protocol_io == NULL)
  {
    return;
  }
  memset(protocol_io, 0, sizeof(*protocol_io));
  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return;
  }
  protocol_io->context = context;
  protocol_io->send_datagram = send_datagram;
  protocol_io->receive_datagram = receive_datagram;
  protocol_io->now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds;
  protocol_io->read_file = read_file;
  protocol_io->write_file = write_file;
  protocol_io->flush_file = flush_file;
  protocol_io->close_file = close_file;
}

int rdt_io_close(struct rdt_io_context *context)
{
  int result = 0;

  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return 0;
  }
  if (context->file != NULL && fclose(context->file) != 0)
  { // GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not close transfer file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    result = -1;
  } // GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  if (context->socket_fd >= 0 && close(context->socket_fd) != 0)
  {// GCOVR_EXCL_START
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not close relay socket: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    result = -1;
  }// GCOVR_EXCL_STOP
  free(context);
  return result;
}

static int receive_packet(const struct rdt_protocol_io *io, int timeout_ms,
                          struct received_packet *received)

    size_t length = 0U;

    if (timeout_ms >= 0)

#ifndef RDT_H
#define RDT_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/** Size in bytes of the fixed portion of an RDT datagram. */
#define RDT_HEADER_SIZE 10U

/** Maximum number of file-data bytes carried by one DATA datagram. */
#define RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD 1024U

/** Maximum total RDT datagram size, including its header. */
#define RDT_MAX_PACKET (RDT_HEADER_SIZE + RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD)

/**
 * RDT datagram type values. These values are part of the wire protocol.
 */
enum rdt_packet_type
{
  RDT_DATA = 0,
  RDT_ACK = 1,
  RDT_FIN = 2
};

/**
 * Configuration for a transfer and its relay registration.
 *
 * The session string is used during the relay HELLO handshake. window_size and
 * timeout_ms are used by the sender; loss, corrupt, and duplicate are sent to
 * the relay in the sender's HELLO. port selects the relay's UDP port.
 */
struct rdt_options
{
  const char *session;       /**< Shared relay session name. */
  unsigned int window_size;  /**< Sender's Go-Back-N window, 1-64 packets. */
  unsigned int timeout_ms;   /**< Sender retransmission timeout in ms. */
  unsigned short port;       /**< Relay UDP port. */
  double loss;               /**< Relay packet-loss probability, 0-0.5. */
  double corrupt;            /**< Relay packet-corruption probability, 0-0.5. */
  double duplicate;          /**< Relay duplication probability, 0-0.5. */
};

/**
 * Check the session-name syntax expected by the relay.
 *
 * @param session Name to validate; must contain 1-32 lowercase letters,
 *                digits, or hyphens.
 * @return 0 when valid, or -1 for NULL or an invalid name.
 */
int rdt_validate_session(const char *session);

/**
 * Encode one RDT datagram into its wire representation.
 *
 * The header consists of type, a zero reserved byte, a 16-bit Internet
 * checksum, a 32-bit sequence number, and a 16-bit payload length. Multi-byte
 * fields are in network byte order.
 *
 * @param packet Destination buffer.
 * @param capacity Available bytes in packet.
 * @param type DATA, ACK, or FIN.
 * @param sequence 32-bit datagram sequence number.
 * @param payload Payload bytes, or NULL when payload_length is zero.
 * @param payload_length Payload size, at most RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD.
 * @return Encoded datagram length, or 0 if the arguments/capacity are invalid.
 */
size_t rdt_encode_packet(uint8_t *packet, size_t capacity,
                         enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                         const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t payload_length);

/**
 * Validate and decode an RDT datagram.
 *
 * Optional output pointers may be NULL. The decoded payload points into the
 * input packet and remains valid only as long as that packet's storage.
 *
 * @param packet Datagram bytes to validate.
 * @param packet_length Datagram size.
 * @param type Receives the decoded type, when non-NULL.
 * @param sequence Receives the decoded sequence number, when non-NULL.
 * @param payload Receives a pointer to the payload, when non-NULL.
 * @param payload_length Receives the payload size, when non-NULL.
 * @return 0 on success, or -1 for invalid type, reserved byte, length, or
 *         checksum.
 */
int rdt_decode_packet(const uint8_t *packet, size_t packet_length,
                      enum rdt_packet_type *type, uint32_t *sequence,
                      const uint8_t **payload, uint32_t *payload_length);

/**
 * Send a regular file through the relay using Go-Back-N.
 *
 * Registers as the session sender, sends the file in RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD-sized
 * DATA chunks, retransmits unacknowledged windows on timeout, then retries FIN
 * until its final ACK arrives or ten FIN timeouts expire.
 *
 * @param host Relay host name or numeric address.
 * @param port Relay UDP port.
 * @param path Path to the regular input file.
 * @param options Transfer and relay settings.
 * @return 0 on success, 2 if FIN receives no ACK after ten retransmission
 *         timeouts, or 1 for other failures.
 */
int rdt_send_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                  const struct rdt_options *options);

/**
 * Receive one file through the relay.
 *
 * Registers as the session receiver, writes only DATA at the next expected
 * sequence number, sends cumulative ACKs for received or discarded packets,
 * then acknowledges FIN and lingers through the sender's bounded FIN retry
 * period.
 *
 * @param host Relay host name or numeric address.
 * @param port Relay UDP port.
 * @param path Destination file path; it is opened/truncated after registration.
 * @param options Transfer and relay settings.
 * @return 0 on success, 2 if no valid packet arrives for 30 seconds, or 1 for
 *         other file or communication failures.
 */
int rdt_receive_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                     const struct rdt_options *options);

#endif

#ifndef RDT_IO_H
#define RDT_IO_H

#include "rdt_protocol.h"

struct rdt_io_context;

/*
 * Concrete operating-system adapter: owns the UDP socket, relay HELLO,
 * monotonic clock, and source/destination FILE.
 */

/**
 * Resolve/connect the relay, complete HELLO, and open the source/destination.
 * The sender's file size is returned through file_size when that pointer is
 * non-NULL. The receiver output is opened only after relay registration.
 *
 * @return An owned I/O context, or NULL on failure.
 */
struct rdt_io_context *rdt_io_open(const char *host, unsigned short port,
                                   const char *path,
                                   const struct rdt_options *options,
                                   int sender, uint64_t *file_size);

/**
 * Populate protocol callbacks backed by the supplied adapter context.
 * A NULL context clears the callback table; a NULL output pointer is ignored.
 */
void rdt_io_get_protocol_io(struct rdt_io_context *context,
                            struct rdt_protocol_io *io);

/** Close the file and UDP socket, release context; return -1 on close error. */
int rdt_io_close(struct rdt_io_context *context);

#endif

struct linger_test_context
{
  uint64_t now_ms;
  uint8_t incoming[4][RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  size_t incoming_lengths[4];
  size_t incoming_count;
  size_t next_incoming;
  uint32_t acknowledgements[4];
  size_t acknowledgement_count;
  uint8_t written[8];
  size_t written_length;
  unsigned int flush_count;
  unsigned int close_count;
  int fin_ack_before_close;
};

static int linger_test_send(void *context, const uint8_t *packet,
                            size_t length)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  enum rdt_packet_type type;
  uint32_t sequence;

  if (test->acknowledgement_count >=
          sizeof(test->acknowledgements) / sizeof(test->acknowledgements[0]) ||
      rdt_decode_packet(packet, length, &type, &sequence, NULL, NULL) != 0 ||
      type != RDT_ACK)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->acknowledgements[test->acknowledgement_count] = sequence;
  if (sequence == 2U && test->close_count == 0U)
  {
    test->fin_ack_before_close = 1;
  }
  ++test->acknowledgement_count;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_receive(void *context, uint8_t *packet,
                               size_t capacity, size_t *length,
                               int timeout_ms)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;

  if (test->next_incoming < test->incoming_count)
  {
    size_t packet_length = test->incoming_lengths[test->next_incoming];
    if (capacity < packet_length)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    memcpy(packet, test->incoming[test->next_incoming], packet_length);
    *length = packet_length;
    ++test->next_incoming;
    return 0;
  }
  if (timeout_ms < 0)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->now_ms += (uint64_t) timeout_ms;
  return 1;
}

static uint64_t linger_test_clock(void *context)
{
  const struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  return test->now_ms;
}

static int linger_test_read(void *context, uint8_t *bytes, size_t length)
{
  (void) context;
  (void) bytes;
  (void) length;
  return -1;
}

static int linger_test_write(void *context, const uint8_t *bytes,
                             size_t length)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;

  if (length > sizeof(test->written) - test->written_length)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  memcpy(test->written + test->written_length, bytes, length);
  test->written_length += length;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_flush(void *context)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  ++test->flush_count;
  return 0;
}

static int linger_test_close(void *context)
{
  struct linger_test_context *test = context;
  ++test->close_count;
  return 0;
}

static int queue_linger_packet(struct linger_test_context *test,
                               enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                               const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t length)
{
  size_t packet_length;

  if (test->incoming_count >=
      sizeof(test->incoming) / sizeof(test->incoming[0]))
  {
    return -1;
  }
  packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(test->incoming[test->incoming_count],
                                    sizeof(test->incoming[0]), type, sequence,
                                    payload, length);
  if (packet_length == 0U)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  test->incoming_lengths[test->incoming_count] = packet_length;
  ++test->incoming_count;
  return 0;
}

static void test_receiver_linger_reacks_duplicate_fin_and_data(void)
{
  const uint8_t data[] = {'x'};
  uint8_t fin_timeout[] = {0U, 50U};
  const uint8_t alternate_fin_payload[] = {0xa5U};
  struct linger_test_context test = {.now_ms = 100U};
  struct rdt_protocol_io io = {
    .context = &test,
    .send_datagram = linger_test_send,
    .receive_datagram = linger_test_receive,
    .now_ms = linger_test_clock,
    .read_file = linger_test_read,
    .write_file = linger_test_write,
    .flush_file = linger_test_flush,
    .close_file = linger_test_close
  };
  struct rdt_options options = {
    .session = "linger-test",
    .window_size = 4U,
    .timeout_ms = 50U,
    .port = 4250U,
    .loss = 0.0,
    .corrupt = 0.0,
    .duplicate = 0.0
  };
  uint64_t start_ms = test.now_ms;

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, queue_linger_packet(&test, RDT_DATA, 0U, data,
                                                sizeof(data)));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, queue_linger_packet(&test, RDT_FIN, 1U,
                                                fin_timeout,
                                                sizeof(fin_timeout)));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, queue_linger_packet(&test, RDT_DATA, 0U, data,
                                                sizeof(data)));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, queue_linger_packet(&test, RDT_FIN, 1U,
                                                alternate_fin_payload,
                                                sizeof(alternate_fin_payload)));

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_protocol_receive(&io, &options));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(1U, test.written_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8('x', test.written[0]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(1U, test.flush_count);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(1U, test.close_count);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, test.fin_ack_before_close);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(3U, test.acknowledgement_count);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(1U, test.acknowledgements[0]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(2U, test.acknowledgements[1]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(2U, test.acknowledgements[2]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT64(UINT64_C(2000), test.now_ms - start_ms);
}

static void test_receiver_gives_up_after_30_seconds_without_valid_packet(void)
{
  struct linger_test_context test = {.now_ms = 500U};
  struct rdt_protocol_io io = {
    .context = &test,
    .send_datagram = linger_test_send,
    .receive_datagram = linger_test_receive,
    .now_ms = linger_test_clock,
    .read_file = linger_test_read,
    .write_file = linger_test_write,
    .flush_file = linger_test_flush,
    .close_file = linger_test_close
  };
  struct rdt_options options = {
    .session = "idle-timeout",
    .window_size = 4U,
    .timeout_ms = 50U,
    .port = 4250U,
    .loss = 0.0,
    .corrupt = 0.0,
    .duplicate = 0.0
  };
  uint64_t start_ms = test.now_ms;

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(2, rdt_protocol_receive(&io, &options));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT64(UINT64_C(30000), test.now_ms - start_ms);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(0U, test.written_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(0U, test.acknowledgement_count);
}

static void test_null_and_invalid_pointer_arguments(void)
{
  struct rdt_options options = {
    .session = "null-check",
    .window_size = 8U,
    .timeout_ms = 50U,
    .port = 4250U,

  };
  struct rdt_protocol_io protocol_io = {0};
  struct rdt_protocol_io complete_io = {
    .context = NULL,
    .send_datagram = null_test_send_datagram,
    .receive_datagram = null_test_receive_datagram,
    .now_ms = null_test_now_ms,
    .read_file = null_test_read_file,
    .write_file = null_test_write_file,
    .flush_file = null_test_flush_file,
    .close_file = null_test_flush_file
  };
  struct rdt_options null_session_options = options;
  uint8_t packet[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  size_t packet_length;

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_io_close(NULL));
  rdt_io_get_protocol_io(NULL, NULL);
  rdt_io_get_protocol_io(NULL, &protocol_io);
  TEST_ASSERT_NULL(protocol_io.context);
  TEST_ASSERT_NULL(protocol_io.send_datagram);
  TEST_ASSERT_NULL(protocol_io.receive_datagram);

static void run_relay_rejection_case(int sender_role)
{
  struct rdt_options options = {
    .session = sender_role != 0 ? "test-rdt-send-err" : "test-rdt-recv-err",
    .window_size = 8U,
    .timeout_ms = 50U,
    .port = 0U,
    .loss = 0.0,
    .corrupt = 0.0,
    .duplicate = 0.0
  };
  char input_path[] = "/tmp/cs425-rdt-hello-XXXXXX";
  uint8_t datagram[128];
  unsigned short port = 0U;
  int relay_fd = make_relay_socket(&port);
  int input_fd = -1;
  int datagram_length;
  int status = 0;
  pid_t worker;
  struct sockaddr_in peer;

  TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(relay_fd >= 0);
  options.port = port;
  if (sender_role != 0)
  {
    input_fd = mkstemp(input_path);
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(input_fd >= 0);
    (void) close(input_fd);
  }

static void run_relay_rejection_case(int sender_role)
{
  struct rdt_options options = {
    .session = sender_role != 0 ? "test-rdt-send-err" : "test-rdt-recv-err",
    .window_size = 8U,
    .timeout_ms = 50U,
    .port = 0U,
    .loss = 0.0,
    .corrupt = 0.0,
    .duplicate = 0.0
  };
  char input_path[] = "/tmp/cs425-rdt-hello-XXXXXX";
  uint8_t datagram[128];
  unsigned short port = 0U;
  int relay_fd = make_relay_socket(&port);
  int input_fd = -1;
  int datagram_length;
  int status = 0;
  pid_t worker;
  struct sockaddr_in peer;

  TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(relay_fd >= 0);
  options.port = port;
  if (sender_role != 0)
  {
    input_fd = mkstemp(input_path);
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(input_fd >= 0);
    (void) close(input_fd);
  }

  (void) fflush(NULL);
  worker = fork();
  TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(worker >= 0);
  if (worker == 0)
  {
    if (sender_role != 0)
    {
      exit(rdt_send_file("127.0.0.1", port, input_path, &options));
    }
    exit(rdt_receive_file("127.0.0.1", port, "/tmp/unused-rdt-output",
                          &options));
  }

  datagram_length = receive_relay_datagram(relay_fd, datagram,
                                           sizeof(datagram), &peer, 1000);
  TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(datagram_length > 0);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, send_relay_datagram(
                               relay_fd,
                               (const uint8_t *) "ERR intentional test error",
                               strlen("ERR intentional test error"), &peer));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(worker, waitpid(worker, &status, 0));
  TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(WIFEXITED(status));
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, WEXITSTATUS(status));
  if (input_fd >= 0)
  {
    (void) unlink(input_path);
  }
  (void) close(relay_fd);
}

static void test_sender_relay_rejection(void)
{
  run_relay_rejection_case(1);
}

static void test_receiver_relay_rejection(void)
{
  run_relay_rejection_case(0);
}

int main(void)
{
  UNITY_BEGIN();
  RUN_TEST(test_session_validation);
  RUN_TEST(test_packet_round_trip);
  RUN_TEST(test_packet_rejects_corruption_and_bad_lengths);
  RUN_TEST(test_ack_and_fin_type_values);
  RUN_TEST(test_encode_rejects_oversized_or_missing_payload);
  RUN_TEST(test_sender_receiver_with_faults);
  RUN_TEST(test_empty_file_transfer);
  RUN_TEST(test_sender_exits_two_after_fin_timeouts);
  RUN_TEST(test_sender_gives_up_after_ten_data_timeouts);
  RUN_TEST(test_sender_timeout_limit_resets_on_cumulative_progress);
  RUN_TEST(test_send_file_failures);
  RUN_TEST(test_receive_output_open_failure);
  RUN_TEST(test_receiver_linger_reacks_duplicate_fin_and_data);

```
newline. The client waits up to one second for a reply and retries at most five
times. `ERR <reason>` is reported to the user.

## Implementation layers

The C implementation separates the wire/protocol concerns from operating
system I/O:

- `rdt.c` validates session names and encodes/decodes the packet header and
  checksum. Its public send/receive functions compose the other layers.
- `rdt_protocol.c` runs the Go-Back-N sender and receiver state machines using
  injected datagram, clock, and file callbacks declared in `rdt_protocol.h`.
- `rdt_io.c` implements those callbacks with UDP sockets, `poll`, the monotonic
  clock, the relay HELLO exchange, and `FILE` operations.

This lets protocol behavior be exercised through alternate callback
implementations without binding it to the socket or filesystem implementation.

## Binary datagrams

Every packet has the following header followed immediately by its payload.
All 16- and 32-bit integers use network byte order.

| Offset | Size | Field |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| 0 | 1 | Type: `0` DATA, `1` ACK, or `2` FIN |
```

I wonder if feeding the event into the state machine would allow for better handling of failed actions. It looks like we need a way to manage failures during both reads and sends while keeping the overall flow smooth.*

/*
 * Packet serialization layer. It owns the wire format and does not perform
 * network, timer, or file operations.
 */
static uint16_t read_u16(const uint8_t *bytes)
{
  uint16_t network_value;
  memcpy(&network_value, bytes, sizeof(network_value));
  return ntohs(network_value);
}

static uint32_t read_u32(const uint8_t *bytes)
{
  uint32_t network_value;
  memcpy(&network_value, bytes, sizeof(network_value));
  return ntohl(network_value);
}

static void write_u16(uint8_t *bytes, uint16_t value)
{
  uint16_t network_value = htons(value);

/*
 * Public entry points compose the I/O adapter with the protocol state machine.
 */
int rdt_send_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                  const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *context;
  uint64_t file_size = 0U;
  int result;
  int close_result;

  context = rdt_io_open(host, port, path, options, 1, &file_size);
  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return 1;
  }
  result = rdt_io_send(context, file_size, options);
  close_result = rdt_io_close(context);

  if (result == 0 && close_result == 0)
  {
    printf("Transfer complete: %" PRIu64 " bytes sent to %s\n", file_size,
           host);
    return 0;
  }
  return result == 2 ? 2 : 1;
}

int rdt_receive_file(const char *host, unsigned short port, const char *path,
                     const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  struct rdt_io_context *context;
  int result;
  int close_result;

  context = rdt_io_open(host, port, path, options, 0, NULL);
  if (context == NULL)
  {
    return 1;
  }
  result = rdt_io_receive(context);
  close_result = rdt_io_close(context);

  if (result == 0 && close_result == 0)
  {
    printf("Transfer complete: file received from %s\n", host);
    return 0;
  }
  return result == 2 ? 2 : 1;
}

static int receive_protocol_packet(struct rdt_io_context *io,
                                   uint64_t deadline_ms,
                                   struct rdt_protocol_packet *packet)
{
  uint8_t bytes[RDT_MAX_PACKET];

  for (;;)
  {
    uint64_t now = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
    int timeout_ms;
    int ready;
    ssize_t received;
    const uint8_t *payload = NULL;

    if (now >= deadline_ms)
    {
      return 1;
    }
    timeout_ms = (int) ((deadline_ms - now) > (uint64_t) INT_MAX
                            ? INT_MAX
                            : deadline_ms - now);
    ready = wait_readable(io->socket_fd, timeout_ms);
    if (ready <= 0)
    {
      return ready == 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }
    do
    {
      received = recv(io->socket_fd, bytes, sizeof(bytes), 0);
    } while (received < 0 && errno == EINTR);
    if (received < 0)
    {
      fprintf(stderr, "UDP receive failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
      return -1;
    }
    if (rdt_decode_packet(bytes, (size_t) received, &packet->type,
                          &packet->sequence, &payload,
                          &packet->payload_length) == 0)
    {
      if (packet->payload_length > 0U)
      {
        memcpy(packet->payload, payload, packet->payload_length);
      }
      return 0;
    }
  }
}

static int sender_dispatch(struct rdt_io_context *io,
                           struct rdt_sender *sender,
                           const struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  size_t i;

  for (i = 0U; i < actions->count; ++i)
  {
    const struct rdt_protocol_action *action = &actions->items[i];
    struct rdt_protocol_actions next_actions;
    struct rdt_sender_event event;
    int result;

    switch (action->type)
    {
    case RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE:
    {
      uint8_t bytes[RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD];
      if (read_file(io, bytes, action->length) != 0)
      {
        memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
        event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE;
      }
      else
      {
        memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
        event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY;
        event.now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
        event.bytes = bytes;
        event.length = action->length;
      }
      result = rdt_sender_step(sender, &event, &next_actions);
      if (result != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      result = sender_dispatch(io, sender, &next_actions);
      return result;
    }
    case RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET:
      if (send_datagram(io, action->bytes, action->length) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      break;
    case RDT_ACTION_WAIT_UNTIL:
      memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
      result = receive_protocol_packet(io, action->deadline_ms,
                                       &event.packet);
      event.now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
      event.type = result == 0 ? RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK
                               : RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER;
      if (result < 0)
      {
        event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE;
      }
      if (rdt_sender_step(sender, &event, &next_actions) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      return sender_dispatch(io, sender, &next_actions);
    case RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE:
      return 0;
    case RDT_ACTION_FAILED:
      if (action->status == 2)
      {
        fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", sender->finishing != 0
                                    ? "FIN was not acknowledged after 10 timeouts"
                                    : "DATA was not acknowledged after 10 timeouts");
      }
      return action->status;
    case RDT_ACTION_NONE:
    case RDT_ACTION_WRITE_FILE:
    case RDT_ACTION_FLUSH_FILE:
    case RDT_ACTION_CLOSE_FILE:
      return 1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

int rdt_io_send(struct rdt_io_context *context, uint64_t file_size,
                const struct rdt_options *options)
{
  struct rdt_sender sender;
  struct rdt_protocol_actions actions;

  if (context == NULL || options == NULL ||
      rdt_sender_init(&sender, file_size, options->window_size,
                      options->timeout_ms, monotonic_milliseconds(context),
                      &actions) != 0)
  {
    fprintf(stderr, "Invalid sender protocol configuration\n");
    return 1;
  }
  return sender_dispatch(context, &sender, &actions);
}

static int receiver_dispatch(struct rdt_io_context *io,
                             struct rdt_receiver *receiver,
                             const struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  size_t i;

  for (i = 0U; i < actions->count; ++i)
  {
    const struct rdt_protocol_action *action = &actions->items[i];
    struct rdt_protocol_actions next_actions;
    struct rdt_receiver_event event;
    int result;

    switch (action->type)
    {
    case RDT_ACTION_WRITE_FILE:
      result = write_file(io, action->bytes, action->length);
      memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
      event.type = result == 0 ? RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_FILE_OK
                               : RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE;
      event.now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
      if (rdt_receiver_step(receiver, &event, &next_actions) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      result = receiver_dispatch(io, receiver, &next_actions);
      if (result != 0)
      {
        return result;
      }
      break;
    case RDT_ACTION_FLUSH_FILE:
    case RDT_ACTION_CLOSE_FILE:
      result = action->type == RDT_ACTION_FLUSH_FILE
                   ? flush_file(io)
                   : close_file(io);
      memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
      event.type = result == 0 ? RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_FILE_OK
                               : RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE;
      event.now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
      if (rdt_receiver_step(receiver, &event, &next_actions) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      result = receiver_dispatch(io, receiver, &next_actions);
      if (result != 0)
      {
        return result;
      }
      break;
    case RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET:
      if (send_datagram(io, action->bytes, action->length) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      break;
    case RDT_ACTION_WAIT_UNTIL:
      memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
      result = receive_protocol_packet(io, action->deadline_ms,
                                       &event.packet);
      event.now_ms = monotonic_milliseconds(io);
      event.type = result == 0 ? RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_PACKET
                               : RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_TIMER;
      if (result < 0)
      {
        event.type = RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE;
      }
      if (rdt_receiver_step(receiver, &event, &next_actions) != 0)
      {
        return 1;
      }
      return receiver_dispatch(io, receiver, &next_actions);
    case RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE:
      return 0;
    case RDT_ACTION_FAILED:
      if (action->status == 2)
      {
        fprintf(stderr, "Receiver timed out without a valid packet\n");
      }
      return action->status;
    case RDT_ACTION_NONE:
    case RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE:
      return 1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

int rdt_io_receive(struct rdt_io_context *context)
{
  struct rdt_receiver receiver;
  struct rdt_protocol_actions actions;

  if (context == NULL ||
      rdt_receiver_init(&receiver, monotonic_milliseconds(context),
                        &actions) != 0)
  {
    fprintf(stderr, "Invalid receiver protocol configuration\n");
    return 1;
  }
  return receiver_dispatch(context, &receiver, &actions);
}

### Reasoning

***Finalizing tests and potential issues**

I need to ensure that all 17 tests pass, checking for any leaks. The output from `make leak-test` shows prior success without issues. I'll conduct another round with parallel commands for debug and leak tests, which also returned the expected 17 passes. I should confirm that no unexpected changes were created in the process through a `git diff`. 

I noticed some options were omitted in `rdt_io_receive`, which could have implications. Additionally, I’m considering whether to include updates in the rdt_io public API documentation; it doesn't seem necessary right now, but there is a potential issue with the initial sender window fetching chunks synchronously.

**Understanding sender actions**

The `RDT_ACTION_WAIT_UNTIL` is combined by `sender_wait_or_read` after the READ action. The driver continues reading until the window is full, then it waits. When full, the ACK event moves forward, leading to a READ action and WAIT because the timer is active. 

If `sender_wait_or_read` completes, it starts a FIN and returns WAIT. If there are no packets at the start, it goes to FIN and waits, activating the timer. 

In the receiver’s `receiver_step`, if data triggers WRITE with no timer action, it executes and registers ACK + WAIT. If there's an unrelated valid ACK while the receiver is active, it waits instead of sending. In linger packet situations, duplicates cause reACK but don’t enforce matching FIN payload. After closing, FIN is expected and increments when ACKed. Finally, tests for fin linger conclude after the time event.

**Evaluating protocol actions**

I'm thinking about the `rdt_protocol_actions` struct, which has 66 entries of large structs. When I call `rdt_sender_step` with local `next_actions` in the I/O driver, the stack usage is around 70KB, sitting under the 8MB limit. 

The action struct includes RDT_MAX_PACKET bytes even for read/wait, which is about 1048 bytes. Given the sender state is approximately 66KB and there are three locals totaling around 210KB, it’s manageable. I noticed there are no comments in the header regarding action status, but that’s okay.*

#ifndef RDT_PROTOCOL_H
#define RDT_PROTOCOL_H

#include "rdt.h"

enum rdt_protocol_action_type
{
  RDT_ACTION_NONE,
  RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE,
  RDT_ACTION_WRITE_FILE,
  RDT_ACTION_FLUSH_FILE,
  RDT_ACTION_CLOSE_FILE,
  RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET,
  RDT_ACTION_WAIT_UNTIL,
  RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE,
  RDT_ACTION_FAILED
};

/** Actions contain encoded datagrams, file data, deadlines, or final status. */
struct rdt_protocol_action
{
  enum rdt_protocol_action_type type;
  uint64_t deadline_ms;
  size_t length;
  uint8_t bytes[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  int status;
};

struct rdt_protocol_actions
{
  struct rdt_protocol_action items[66];
  size_t count;
};

struct rdt_protocol_packet
{
  enum rdt_packet_type type;
  uint32_t sequence;
  uint32_t payload_length;
  uint8_t payload[RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD];
};

/** Input events contain only protocol data and caller-supplied monotonic time. */
enum rdt_sender_event_type
{
  RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY,
  RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK,
  RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER,
  RDT_SENDER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE
};

struct rdt_sender_event
{
  enum rdt_sender_event_type type;
  uint64_t now_ms;
  const uint8_t *bytes;
  size_t length;
  struct rdt_protocol_packet packet;
};

struct rdt_sender_slot
{
  uint8_t bytes[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  size_t length;
};

struct rdt_sender
{
  uint64_t file_size;
  uint64_t total_packets;
  uint64_t base;
  uint64_t next_sequence;
  uint64_t deadline_ms;
  unsigned int window_size;
  unsigned int timeout_ms;
  unsigned int consecutive_timeouts;
  int timer_active;
  int read_pending;
  int finishing;
  int done;
  struct rdt_sender_slot slots[64];
};

enum rdt_receiver_event_type
{
  RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_PACKET,
  RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_TIMER,
  RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_FILE_OK,
  RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE
};

struct rdt_receiver_event
{
  enum rdt_receiver_event_type type;
  uint64_t now_ms;
  struct rdt_protocol_packet packet;
};

enum rdt_receiver_phase
{
  RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE,
  RDT_RECEIVER_WRITING,
  RDT_RECEIVER_FLUSHING,
  RDT_RECEIVER_CLOSING,
  RDT_RECEIVER_LINGER,

};

struct rdt_receiver
{

  uint64_t idle_deadline_ms;
  uint64_t linger_deadline_ms;
  uint32_t fin_sequence;
  enum rdt_receiver_phase phase;
  uint8_t pending_payload[RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD];
  uint32_t pending_length;
};

/**
 * Initialize the pure sender state machine and return its first action.
 * The machine performs no I/O; callers satisfy requested actions and feed
 * their outcomes back through rdt_sender_step.
 */
int rdt_sender_init(struct rdt_sender *sender, uint64_t file_size,
                    unsigned int window_size, unsigned int timeout_ms,
                    uint64_t now_ms, struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions);

/** Feed one event into the sender and receive the resulting actions. */
int rdt_sender_step(struct rdt_sender *sender,
                    const struct rdt_sender_event *event,
                    struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions);

/** Initialize the pure receiver state machine and its idle deadline. */
int rdt_receiver_init(struct rdt_receiver *receiver, uint64_t now_ms,
                      struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions);

/** Feed one event into the receiver and receive the resulting actions. */
int rdt_receiver_step(struct rdt_receiver *receiver,

#include "rdt_protocol.h"

#include <string.h>

#define DATA_MAX_TIMEOUTS 10U
#define FIN_MAX_TIMEOUTS 10U
#define FIN_LINGER_MS UINT64_C(2000)
#define RECEIVE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS UINT64_C(30000)

static void clear_actions(struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  actions->count = 0U;
}

static struct rdt_protocol_action *add_action(
    struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions,
    enum rdt_protocol_action_type type)
{
  struct rdt_protocol_action *action;

  if (actions->count >=
      sizeof(actions->items) / sizeof(actions->items[0]))
  {
    return NULL;
  }
  action = &actions->items[actions->count++];
  memset(action, 0, sizeof(*action));
  action->type = type;
  return action;
}

static int add_wait(struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions, uint64_t deadline)
{
  struct rdt_protocol_action *action =
      add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_WAIT_UNTIL);
  if (action == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  action->deadline_ms = deadline;
  return 0;
}

static int add_packet(struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions,
                      enum rdt_packet_type type, uint32_t sequence,
                      const uint8_t *payload, uint32_t payload_length)
{
  struct rdt_protocol_action *action =
      add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET);

  if (action == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  action->length = rdt_encode_packet(action->bytes, sizeof(action->bytes),
                                     type, sequence, payload, payload_length);
  return action->length == 0U ? -1 : 0;
}

static int add_status_action(struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions,
                             enum rdt_protocol_action_type type, int status)
{
  struct rdt_protocol_action *action = add_action(actions, type);
  if (action == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  action->status = status;
  return 0;
}

static int sender_request_read(struct rdt_sender *sender,
                               struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  uint64_t offset;
  uint64_t remaining;
  size_t length;
  struct rdt_protocol_action *action;

  if (sender->read_pending != 0 || sender->next_sequence >= sender->total_packets ||
      sender->next_sequence - sender->base >= sender->window_size)
  {
    return 0;
  }
  offset = sender->next_sequence * (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD;
  remaining = sender->file_size - offset;
  length = remaining > (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD
               ? (size_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD
               : (size_t) remaining;
  action = add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE);
  if (action == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  action->length = length;
  sender->read_pending = 1;
  return 0;
}

static int sender_wait_or_read(struct rdt_sender *sender, uint64_t now_ms,
                               struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  if (sender->base == sender->total_packets &&
      sender->next_sequence == sender->total_packets)
  {
    if (sender->finishing == 0)
    {
      sender->finishing = 1;
      sender->timer_active = 1;
      sender->deadline_ms = now_ms + (uint64_t) sender->timeout_ms;
      if (add_packet(actions, RDT_FIN, (uint32_t) sender->total_packets,
                     NULL, 0U) != 0)
      {
        return -1;
      }
    }
    return add_wait(actions, sender->deadline_ms);
  }
  if (sender_request_read(sender, actions) != 0)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  if (sender->timer_active != 0)
  {
    return add_wait(actions, sender->deadline_ms);
  }
  return 0;
}

int rdt_sender_init(struct rdt_sender *sender, uint64_t file_size,
                    unsigned int window_size, unsigned int timeout_ms,
                    uint64_t now_ms, struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  if (sender == NULL || actions == NULL || window_size == 0U ||
      window_size > 64U || timeout_ms == 0U || timeout_ms > 60000U)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  memset(sender, 0, sizeof(*sender));
  clear_actions(actions);
  sender->file_size = file_size;
  sender->total_packets =
      file_size / (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD +
      (file_size % (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD == 0U ? 0U : 1U);
  if (sender->total_packets >= (uint64_t) UINT32_MAX)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  sender->window_size = window_size;
  sender->timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
  if (sender->total_packets == 0U)
  {
    return sender_wait_or_read(sender, now_ms, actions);
  }
  return sender_request_read(sender, actions);
}

static int sender_emit_outstanding(struct rdt_sender *sender,
                                   struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  uint64_t sequence;

  for (sequence = sender->base; sequence < sender->next_sequence; ++sequence)
  {
    struct rdt_sender_slot *slot =
        &sender->slots[sequence % (uint64_t) sender->window_size];
    struct rdt_protocol_action *action =
        add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET);
    if (action == NULL)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    memcpy(action->bytes, slot->bytes, slot->length);
    action->length = slot->length;
  }
  return 0;
}

int rdt_sender_step(struct rdt_sender *sender,
                    const struct rdt_sender_event *event,
                    struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  if (sender == NULL || event == NULL || actions == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  clear_actions(actions);
  if (sender->done != 0)
  {
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE, 0);
  }
  if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE)
  {
    sender->done = 1;
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 1);
  }

  if (sender->finishing != 0)
  {
    if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK &&
        event->packet.type == RDT_ACK &&
        event->packet.payload_length == 0U &&
        (uint64_t) event->packet.sequence == sender->total_packets + 1U)
    {
      sender->done = 1;
      return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE, 0);
    }
    if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER &&
        event->now_ms >= sender->deadline_ms)
    {
      ++sender->consecutive_timeouts;
      if (sender->consecutive_timeouts >= FIN_MAX_TIMEOUTS)
      {
        sender->done = 1;
        return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 2);
      }
      sender->deadline_ms = event->now_ms + (uint64_t) sender->timeout_ms;
      if (add_packet(actions, RDT_FIN, (uint32_t) sender->total_packets,
                     NULL, 0U) != 0)
      {
        return -1;
      }
    }
    return add_wait(actions, sender->deadline_ms);
  }

  if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY)
  {
    uint64_t offset;
    uint64_t remaining;
    size_t expected_length;
    struct rdt_sender_slot *slot;

    if (sender->read_pending == 0 || event->bytes == NULL)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    offset = sender->next_sequence * (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD;
    remaining = sender->file_size - offset;
    expected_length = remaining > (uint64_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD
                          ? (size_t) RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD
                          : (size_t) remaining;
    if (event->length != expected_length)
    {
      sender->done = 1;
      return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 1);
    }
    slot = &sender->slots[sender->next_sequence %
                          (uint64_t) sender->window_size];
    slot->length = rdt_encode_packet(
        slot->bytes, sizeof(slot->bytes), RDT_DATA,
        (uint32_t) sender->next_sequence, event->bytes,
        (uint32_t) event->length);
    if (slot->length == 0U)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    sender->read_pending = 0;
    if (add_packet(actions, RDT_DATA, (uint32_t) sender->next_sequence,
                   event->bytes, (uint32_t) event->length) != 0)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    ++sender->next_sequence;
    if (sender->timer_active == 0)
    {
      sender->timer_active = 1;
      sender->deadline_ms = event->now_ms + (uint64_t) sender->timeout_ms;
    }
    return sender_wait_or_read(sender, event->now_ms, actions);
  }

  if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK &&
      event->packet.type == RDT_ACK &&
      event->packet.payload_length == 0U &&
      (uint64_t) event->packet.sequence > sender->base &&
      (uint64_t) event->packet.sequence <= sender->next_sequence)
  {
    sender->base = event->packet.sequence;
    sender->consecutive_timeouts = 0U;
    if (sender->base < sender->next_sequence)
    {
      sender->timer_active = 1;
      sender->deadline_ms = event->now_ms + (uint64_t) sender->timeout_ms;
    }
    else
    {
      sender->timer_active = 0;
    }
    return sender_wait_or_read(sender, event->now_ms, actions);
  }

  if (event->type == RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER &&
      sender->timer_active != 0 && event->now_ms >= sender->deadline_ms)
  {
    ++sender->consecutive_timeouts;
    if (sender->consecutive_timeouts >= DATA_MAX_TIMEOUTS)
    {
      sender->done = 1;
      return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 2);
    }
    if (sender_emit_outstanding(sender, actions) != 0)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    sender->deadline_ms = event->now_ms + (uint64_t) sender->timeout_ms;
  }
  return sender_wait_or_read(sender, event->now_ms, actions);
}

static int receiver_ack(struct rdt_receiver *receiver,
                        struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  return add_packet(actions, RDT_ACK, (uint32_t) receiver->expected, NULL, 0U);
}

int rdt_receiver_init(struct rdt_receiver *receiver, uint64_t now_ms,
                      struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  if (receiver == NULL || actions == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  memset(receiver, 0, sizeof(*receiver));
  clear_actions(actions);
  receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE;
  receiver->idle_deadline_ms = now_ms + RECEIVE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS;
  return add_wait(actions, receiver->idle_deadline_ms);
}

int rdt_receiver_step(struct rdt_receiver *receiver,
                      const struct rdt_receiver_event *event,
                      struct rdt_protocol_actions *actions)
{
  if (receiver == NULL || event == NULL || actions == NULL)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  clear_actions(actions);
  if (event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_IO_FAILURE)
  {
    receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_FAILED;
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 1);
  }
  if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_DONE)
  {
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE, 0);
  }
  if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_FAILED)
  {
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 1);
  }
  if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE &&
      event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_TIMER &&
      event->now_ms >= receiver->idle_deadline_ms)
  {
    receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_FAILED;
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FAILED, 2);
  }
  if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_LINGER &&
      event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_TIMER &&
      event->now_ms >= receiver->linger_deadline_ms)
  {
    receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_DONE;
    return add_status_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE, 0);
  }

  if (event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_PACKET &&
      receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE)
  {
    receiver->idle_deadline_ms = event->now_ms + RECEIVE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    if (event->packet.type == RDT_DATA)
    {
      if ((uint64_t) event->packet.sequence != receiver->expected ||
          event->packet.payload_length == 0U ||
          event->packet.payload_length > RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD)
      {
        if (receiver_ack(receiver, actions) != 0)
        {
          return -1;
        }
      }
      else
      {
        memcpy(receiver->pending_payload, event->packet.payload,
               event->packet.payload_length);
        receiver->pending_length = event->packet.payload_length;
        receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_WRITING;
        struct rdt_protocol_action *action =
            add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_WRITE_FILE);
        if (action == NULL)
        {
          return -1;
        }
        memcpy(action->bytes, receiver->pending_payload,
               receiver->pending_length);
        action->length = receiver->pending_length;
      }
    }
    else if (event->packet.type == RDT_FIN)
    {
      if ((uint64_t) event->packet.sequence != receiver->expected)
      {
        if (receiver_ack(receiver, actions) != 0)
        {
          return -1;
        }
      }
      else
      {
        receiver->fin_sequence = event->packet.sequence;
        receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_FLUSHING;
        if (add_action(actions, RDT_ACTION_FLUSH_FILE) == NULL)
        {
          return -1;
        }
      }
    }
    if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE &&
        add_wait(actions, receiver->idle_deadline_ms) != 0)
    {
      return -1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_LINGER &&
      event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_PACKET)
  {
    if (event->packet.type == RDT_FIN &&
        event->packet.sequence == receiver->fin_sequence)
    {
      receiver->expected = (uint64_t) receiver->fin_sequence + 1U;
      if (receiver_ack(receiver, actions) != 0)
      {
        return -1;
      }
    }
    return add_wait(actions, receiver->linger_deadline_ms);
  }

  if (event->type == RDT_RECEIVER_EVENT_FILE_OK)
  {
    if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_WRITING)
    {
      ++receiver->expected;
      receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_ACTIVE;
      receiver->idle_deadline_ms = event->now_ms + RECEIVE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS;
      if (receiver_ack(receiver, actions) != 0 ||

    }
    if (receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_CLOSING)
    {
      receiver->expected = (uint64_t) receiver->fin_sequence + 1U;
      receiver->phase = RDT_RECEIVER_LINGER;
      receiver->linger_deadline_ms = event->now_ms + FIN_LINGER_MS;
      if (receiver_ack(receiver, actions) != 0 ||
          add_wait(actions, receiver->linger_deadline_ms) != 0)
      {
        return -1;
      }
      return 0;
    }
  }

  {
    return receiver->phase == RDT_RECEIVER_LINGER
               ? add_wait(actions, receiver->linger_deadline_ms)
               : add_wait(actions, receiver->idle_deadline_ms);
  }
  return 0;
}

{

  uint8_t packet[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  const uint8_t *decoded_payload = NULL;
  enum rdt_packet_type type = RDT_ACK;
  uint32_t sequence = 0U;
  uint32_t payload_length = 0U;
  size_t packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(
      packet, sizeof(packet), RDT_DATA, UINT32_C(0x12345678),
      payload, sizeof(payload));

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(RDT_HEADER_SIZE + sizeof(payload), packet_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[0]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[1]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0x12U, packet[4]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0x34U, packet[5]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0x56U, packet[6]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0x78U, packet[7]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[8]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(4U, packet[9]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(
      0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, &type, &sequence,
                           &decoded_payload, &payload_length));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_DATA, type);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(UINT32_C(0x12345678), sequence);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(sizeof(payload), payload_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_MEMORY(payload, decoded_payload, sizeof(payload));
}

static void test_packet_rejects_corruption_and_bad_lengths(void)
{
  const uint8_t payload[] = {1U, 2U, 3U};
  uint8_t packet[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  size_t packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(packet, sizeof(packet), RDT_DATA,
                                           7U, payload, sizeof(payload));

  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length - 1U,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL));
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length + 1U,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL));
  packet[RDT_HEADER_SIZE + 1U] ^= 1U;
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL));
  packet[RDT_HEADER_SIZE + 1U] ^= 1U;
  packet[4] = 2U;
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL));
  packet[4] = 7U;
  packet[0] = 3U;
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL));
  packet[0] = (uint8_t) RDT_DATA;
  packet[1] = 1U;
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL));
  packet[1] = 0U;
  packet[8] = 4U;
  packet[9] = 1U;
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL));
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(NULL, packet_length, NULL, NULL,
                                              NULL, NULL));
  TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, RDT_HEADER_SIZE - 1U,
                                              NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL));
}

{
  const uint8_t finish_payload[] = {0x01U, 0xf4U};
  uint8_t packet[RDT_MAX_PACKET];
  enum rdt_packet_type type = RDT_DATA;
  uint32_t sequence = 0U;
  uint32_t payload_length = 0U;
  size_t packet_length;

  packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(packet, sizeof(packet), RDT_ACK,
                                   UINT32_C(0x01020304), NULL, 0U);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(RDT_HEADER_SIZE, packet_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(1U, packet[0]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[1]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(
      0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, &type, &sequence, NULL,
                           &payload_length));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACK, type);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(UINT32_C(0x01020304), sequence);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(0U, payload_length);

  packet_length = rdt_encode_packet(packet, sizeof(packet), RDT_FIN, 9U,
                                    finish_payload, sizeof(finish_payload));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(RDT_HEADER_SIZE + sizeof(finish_payload),
                         packet_length);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(2U, packet[0]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[1]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0U, packet[8]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(2U, packet[9]);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(
      0, rdt_decode_packet(packet, packet_length, &type, &sequence, NULL,
                           &payload_length));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_FIN, type);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(9U, sequence);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT(sizeof(finish_payload), payload_length);
}

static int make_relay_socket(unsigned short *port)
{
  struct sockaddr_in address;
  socklen_t address_length = (socklen_t) sizeof(address);
  int socket_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);

  if (socket_fd < 0)
  {
    return -1;
  }
  memset(&address, 0, sizeof(address));
  address.sin_family = AF_INET;
  address.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
  address.sin_port = htons(0U);
  if (bind(socket_fd, (struct sockaddr *) &address, sizeof(address)) != 0 ||
      getsockname(socket_fd, (struct sockaddr *) &address, &address_length) !=
          0)
  {
    (void) close(socket_fd);
    return -1;
  }
  *port = ntohs(address.sin_port);
  return socket_fd;
}

static void test_sender_gives_up_after_ten_data_timeouts(void)
{
  struct rdt_sender sender;
  struct rdt_protocol_actions actions;
  struct rdt_sender_event event = {0};
  uint8_t data[] = {0x41U};
  unsigned int timeout;

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_init(&sender, sizeof(data), 1U, 10U,
                                           0U, &actions));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE, actions.items[0].type);
  event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY;
  event.now_ms = 0U;
  event.bytes = data;
  event.length = sizeof(data);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET, actions.items[0].type);
  for (timeout = 1U; timeout <= 10U; ++timeout)
  {
    event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER;
    event.now_ms = (uint64_t) timeout * UINT64_C(10);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  }
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_FAILED, actions.items[0].type);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(2, actions.items[0].status);
}

static void test_sender_timeout_limit_resets_on_cumulative_progress(void)
{
  struct rdt_sender sender;
  struct rdt_protocol_actions actions;
  struct rdt_sender_event event = {0};
  uint8_t data[RDT_MAX_PAYLOAD] = {0};
  unsigned int timeout;

  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_init(&sender, sizeof(data) * 2U, 1U,
                                           10U, 0U, &actions));
  event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY;
  event.bytes = data;
  event.length = sizeof(data);
  event.now_ms = 0U;
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  for (timeout = 1U; timeout <= 9U; ++timeout)
  {
    event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER;
    event.now_ms = (uint64_t) timeout * UINT64_C(10);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  }

  event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK;
  event.now_ms = 90U;
  event.packet.type = RDT_ACK;
  event.packet.sequence = 1U;
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_READ_FILE, actions.items[0].type);

  event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_DATA_READY;
  event.now_ms = 90U;
  event.bytes = data;
  event.length = sizeof(data);
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  for (timeout = 1U; timeout <= 9U; ++timeout)
  {
    event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_TIMER;
    event.now_ms = UINT64_C(90) + (uint64_t) timeout * UINT64_C(10);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  }

  event.type = RDT_SENDER_EVENT_ACK;
  event.now_ms = 190U;
  event.packet.type = RDT_ACK;
  event.packet.sequence = 2U;
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_SEND_PACKET, actions.items[0].type);
  event.packet.sequence = 3U;
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(0, rdt_sender_step(&sender, &event, &actions));
  TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT(RDT_ACTION_COMPLETE, actions.items[0].type);
}
